narrative.overview: Kevin Ding's personal website draws subtle inspiration from his engineering role at Amazon Prime Video and his off-hours love for C-dramas and K-dramas, framing his two flagship software systems (StressAlpha and PokéBastion TD) as widescreen feature releases inside a midnight-blue screening theater.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight Screening Atmosphere: Deep theater slate (#060b14) illuminated by an overhead cobalt-blue projection radial glow (#102347).
Signature X-Ray HUD Bar: Each flagship card opens with a translucent cyan-bordered X-Ray bar displaying system scale and an instant toggle into the live engine.
Widescreen 16:10 Screen Bays: Recessed #04070e viewports frame authentic production screenshots and interactive sandboxes at identical 16:10 proportions.
Zero-Jitter Tabular Readouts: All financial deltas, WACC shocks, and pathfinding node counts enforce font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The X-Ray Inspection Rule
rules.body: Every flagship release card carries a top X-Ray HUD bar (#00a8e1 border on rgba(0, 168, 225, 0.12) fill) that lets visitors toggle the 16:10 screen bay between real production screenshots and the live interactive algorithm engine.

rules.name: The Real-Proof-First Rule
rules.body: Both flagship showcases default to real high-resolution production screenshots so visitors immediately see the authentic shipped UI before exploring the X-Ray sandbox.

rules.name: The Zero-Jitter Tabular Rule
rules.body: All numerical readouts in the X-Ray sandboxes apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (tnum, zero).

rules.name: The No-Kicker Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings lead their container directly or pair inline with a right-aligned status badge; never stack a small kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.

dos: Do lead both flagship cards with real 16:10 production screenshots and provide the X-Ray HUD toggle to inspect the live interactive DCF and A* engines.
Do keep the palette cohesive across deep midnight blues (#060b14, #102347, #10192b) and luminous cyan/sky accents (#00a8e1, #38bdf8, #7dd3fc).
Do enforce tabular-nums on every live valuation delta and pathfinding counter.
donts: Don't use rock-climbing jargon or unrelated sport metaphors on engineering sections.
Don't place kickers or eyebrow labels above <h2> or <h3> headings.
Don't use hard zero-blur neobrutalist offset shadows.
